description: This file defines the GroupField entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing a database table 'ohrm_group_field' with fields for ID, name, group-by clause, and optional widget information. It includes getter and setter methods for each property and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping.

classes.name: GroupField
classes.description: Entity class representing group field configuration in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_group_field' table and including fields for ID, name, grouping clause, and widget information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the group field.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the group field.

methods.name: getGroupByClause
methods.description: Returns the group by clause associated with the group field.

methods.name: setGroupByClause
methods.description: Sets the group by clause associated with the group field.

methods.name: getGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type associated with the group field, if any.

methods.name: setGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for the group field.
